technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot 3.x / Spring Framework 6.x (Java 17+) as the base runtime, consistent with the framework requirement.

Use Maven for dependency management; exploit Maven's dependency mediation rules as the baseline strategy for U2 and complement it with a custom classpath-resolution layer where mediation alone is insufficient.
Model binding selection (U1) through a Spring Cloud Stream binder auto-configuration that is conditionally activated based on classpath presence, with a documented fallback chain.

Implement profile-based backend selection (U6) using Spring's @Profile mechanism; the 'local' profile will back the stream repository with an in-memory implementation; additional profile-specific strategies (e.g., JDBC, file) will follow the same Repository abstraction.
Design the undeploy operation (U5) around a single Undeployer SPI shared by jobs and streams; the singlenode target provides the in-JVM implementation referenced by the linked PR.
Treat the XD -> s-c-s porting foundation (U7) as a design spike plus a thin compatibility shim package; the actual module migration is out of scope for this increment.
Expose counter/metrics (U8) through Spring Boot Actuator endpoints backed by Micrometer, exposing the same counter sources that feed the firehose pipe.
Publish s-c-d images (U3) via a CI workflow (GitHub Actions style) triggered on tagged commits, building a multi-arch Docker image and pushing to Docker Hub under a dedicated repository.
Treat the screencast (U4) as a content deliverable produced by the same developer (screen capture + light editing + upload) rather than a separate media team engagement.
Assume incremental, trunk-based development on the existing spring-cloud-dataflow monorepo with existing modules (Admin, Skipper, etc.) as the integration target.
assumptions: A single experienced s-c-d developer performs all work; estimates reflect a person familiar with Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Boot and Maven.
One workday equals 8 productive hours; no allowance is included for holidays, meetings beyond normal stand-ups, or onboarding.
The existing s-c-d and s-c-s codebases are available locally; setting up the dev environment is not counted as a separate activity.
U2 (dependency resolution) is bounded to a runtime classpath resolution service for the local/singlenode deployer; a full distributed/remote resolution system is out of scope.
U5 (undeploy) is bounded to the singlenode target; cluster-mode undeploy is explicitly out of scope for this increment.
U7 (XD module porting foundation) is bounded to brainstorming and a written design plus a minimal shim skeleton; the actual porting of XD modules is out of scope.
U3 (DockerHub publishing) is bounded to configuring the CI pipeline and a single repository push; multi-account or signed/distroless image hardening is not included.
U4 (screencast) is treated as a development-included deliverable: 1 day is sufficient for recording ~5-10 minutes, light editing, and public hosting.
Unit tests are written inline as part of each implementation activity; the 'integration testing' activity only covers cross-story end-to-end scenarios.
Documentation updates are limited to README/Markdown updates for the affected modules; no full user-guide rewrite is included.

activities.activity_description: Read all 8 user stories, inspect the existing s-c-d/s-c-s codebase, and produce a short design note that maps each story to concrete code areas, calls out dependencies between stories (e.g., U6/U5/U8 touching the Admin app, U1/U2 touching the deployer), and sequences the work.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Investigate binding include/exclude and fallback strategy
activities.activity_description: Investigate how Spring Cloud Stream binders and message-bus jars are currently selected on the classpath, document the selection mechanism, evaluate options for include/exclude rules, and decide on a fallback strategy when no explicit binding is configured.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Implement binding selection and fallback mechanism
activities.activity_description: Implement the chosen include/exclude and fallback mechanism in the s-c-d deployer (Maven coordinates, conditional bean wiring, and configuration properties), wire it into the singlenode target, and add unit tests for the selection rules and fallback path.

Design the runtime dependency resolution service: how versions are declared per module, how conflicts are detected, how the 'winning' artifact set is assembled, and how it integrates with the singlenode deployer classpath.

Implement the resolution service, the conflict-detection logic, and the integration point that adds the resolved jars to the singlenode deployer's runtime classpath. Include unit tests covering the spring-data version-conflict example from the story and a few additional cases.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Add profile support to the core Admin application
activities.activity_description: Introduce Spring @Profile annotations and the corresponding configuration metadata on the core Admin application, refactor the stream repository wiring so the active profile selects the backend implementation, and ensure the default (no-profile) behavior remains backward compatible.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Implement in-memory strategy for the 'local' profile
activities.activity_description: Implement the in-memory StreamRepository (and any required supporting services) that backs the Admin app when the 'local' profile is active, with unit tests for CRUD and basic query operations.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Design consistent undeploy strategy for jobs and streams
activities.activity_description: Decide on a consistent undeploy contract applicable to both jobs and streams, document the Undeployer SPI, and align the singlenode implementation with the proposed PR referenced in the story.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Implement undeploy operation for the singlenode target
activities.activity_description: Implement the undeploy REST endpoint and the in-JVM undeployer for the singlenode target, ensuring it tears down the running app, releases the resolved classpath, and updates the repository state. Add integration tests that deploy then undeploy a sample stream.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Brainstorm and design XD-to-s-c-s module porting foundation
activities.activity_description: Hold a design spike, document the differences between XD modules and s-c-s modules, define the compatibility shim interface, and scaffold the minimal base package that future migrated modules will extend. No actual module is migrated in this increment.
